description.en: Pieverse builds personal AI agents for Web3. Built on Purr-Fect Claw, Pip is designed to support users, builders, and teams across every stage of their Web3 journeys. Equipped with its own computing environment, memory, secure wallets, and extensible skills, Pip brings together market research, asset management, and trading, with an expanding scope across smart contract development, listings, business development, marketing, and project operations. Pieverse is also extending this vision to tokens with their own agents, designed to manage their treasuries, liquidity, and communities. The goal is to empower individuals and teams to build, operate, and grow in Web3 through one personal agent.
